description: Probe a remote MCP server URL once, credential-free and without calling its tools, and get its quality checks and its readiness for the Claude and OpenAI directories. Pass `url` to start a check (waits up to 25 s for the result), or `id` to read one. Quota: a few checks per hour anonymously, more with an API key.

id.description: A check id returned earlier, to read its result

url.description: The server's streamable HTTP or SSE URL, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp. Never include credentials.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result (default 25)

name: check_server
title: Check an MCP server URL
